object.Title: Christ coming to John the Baptist in the desert
object.Description: For the latest information about this object, Christ coming to John the Baptist in the desert, visit the Online Collection of the Walters Art Museum.
object.Provenance: Church of the Holy Sepulchre, Jerusalem, ca. 1598, by gift; Léon Gruel, Paris, by purchase; Henry Walters, Baltimore, purchased from Gruel before 1931; Walters Art Museum, 1931, by bequest.
object.MuseumLocation: To learn whether this object is now on view, and in which gallery, visit https://purl.thewalters.org/art/W.535.14R
